mapper.insert: INSERT INTO loyalty.inbox_event (consumer_name, event_id, tenant_id, program_id, event_type, status) VALUES (#{consumerName}, #{eventId}, #{tenantId}, #{programId}, #{eventType}, 'RECEIVED') ON CONFLICT (consumer_name, event_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE loyalty.inbox_event SET status = 'PROCESSED', processed_at = now() WHERE consumer_name = #{consumerName} AND event_id = #{eventId}
UPDATE loyalty.inbox_event SET status = 'FAILED', error_message = #{error} WHERE consumer_name = #{consumerName} AND event_id = #{eventId}
mapper.select: SELECT consumer_name, event_id, tenant_id, program_id, event_type, status, received_at, processed_at, error_message FROM loyalty.inbox_event WHERE consumer_name = #{consumerName} AND event_id = #{eventId}
